research_scope: Correct the historical Power Wall identity restored in batch 33 from Super/Other to the current documented Ki Blast Ultimate identity.

verification_audit.method: Compared the historical batch-33 record with current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation and the current Ultimate Attack index. The correction changes only the canonical class/subcategory and fills currently supported mechanics/cost/acquisition fields; unresolved Ultimate Finish requirements remain null.
verification_audit.historical_conflict: Batch 33 restored Power Wall as Super/Other with an unknown Ki cost. Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Power Wall as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki and obtained from PQ150 — Battle of the Mind.

corrections.name: Power Wall
corrections.character_source: Jiren (Full Power); Jiren - Customize Partner; Jiren (Full Power) Ultra Supervillain
corrections.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 150 — Battle of the Mind
corrections.skill_description: Generate a giant wall of flame that advances and damages opponents on contact; control-stick input can alter its distance from the user.
corrections.mechanics_notes: The user charges the right hand and swipes downward to create a tall advancing wall of flames. Opponents can be caught during the charge-up stage, and control-stick input manages the wall's distance.
corrections.correction_reason: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Power Wall as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a 500 Ki cost and PQ150 acquisition route. The older batch-33 Super/Other identity is superseded while its historical provenance remains preserved in batch 33.
